en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a gently curving road lined with two‑ and three‑story houses on both sides. A few pedestrians are visible, including a person walking in the middle of the street. Shop signs hang on the buildings to the right. In the distance stands a larger building with a small tower or steeple. The caption printed at the top in red reads "Geithain. Chemnitzer Strasse."
